remarks: Calling all investors. Nicely maintained and updated 2 family home with an in-law. Main level has hardwood floors 2 bedrooms , an updated kitchen and bath. The owner lives there but rent would be 2200 or more. The 2nd unit is on the 2nd and 3rd level. There are 3 bedrooms on the second floor, a full bath and updated kitchen. There are two more bedrooms on the 3rd floor and a bath rents for 4,100, Both units have a large deck that is covered. There is a lower level in-law with 2 bedrooms, a bath and a kitchenette. The roof is two years old and the hot water heaters are both 3 years old. There are 4 parking spaces in front of the house and 3 more in the driveway and back. This is great house with a lot of income potential not to be missed,.
